Allows AD Glasses to read and operate the current Android interface for phone-control actions you request. Optional screenshot capture remains separately controlled.
Allow AD Glasses to find and connect to nearby supported glasses.
Bluetooth permission is used to discover, connect to, and communicate with your glasses. You can continue without it and grant access later when you connect glasses.
Modes, phone control, local models, and cloud AI are optional and can be configured later.
Start with the glasses connection, then enable only the modes and services you want. Each capability can request its own Android permission when it needs one.
AD Glasses is built on open-source components and smart-glasses SDK integrations.
Required license notices remain part of the app distribution. The AD Glasses product UI is separate from the upstream compatibility code it builds on.
Daily Diary can turn selected phone context into private daily facts and summaries.
Enable Daily Diary only if you want it. Its saved context and reminder behavior can be reviewed or disabled later.
Screen Memory can read selected screen text for local context when you enable it.

Screen text may be stored locally for enabled memory features. Phone Control reads the current interface only for actions you request. Apps in your blacklist are skipped. Review the Accessibility disclosure before enabling this optional Android permission.

AD Glasses uses Android Accessibility only if you enable it. Accessibility can let AD Glasses read text and interface structure from apps on your screen and can let Phone Control tap, type, scroll, and navigate for actions you request. Enabled Screen Memory features may save selected screen context locally. When you request a phone-control action, current screen context may be processed by the AI route you selected, including a remote service if you configured one. Optional screenshots remain separately controlled. Apps in your blacklist are skipped. You can disable Accessibility, Screen Memory, or Phone Control at any time.
AD Glasses can collect recent Meta integration state, errors, device details, and filtered diagnostic logs when troubleshooting is needed.
Auto Capture can record glasses audio for transcription and summaries when you enable it.
When enabled, Auto Capture can record audio in chunks and transcribe it for supported workflows. You can review and delete saved recordings from Library.
Choose how the assistant should respond and what personal context it may use.
Assistant preferences and personal context can be changed later from Settings when those capabilities are enabled.
Chats, synced media, notes, and supported memory data are stored on this phone unless a configured capability needs a remote service.

Remote AI, Web Search, or other connected services receive only the data required by the capability you choose to use. Storage, encryption, and relay security are reviewed separately by each runtime rather than implied by this screen.
